title: In this town, every lie makes it rain over your head

lines.text: In this town, every time you tell a *lie*, it starts *raining* over your head.
Just a tiny cloud. Right above you.
When the mayor promised free pizza for everyone, it rained on him for a *week*.
Mister Dale sells used cars. He hasn't been dry in *nine* years.
At school, nobody ever says, I did my homework.
Everyone just looks *up*.
And me? I've *never* had a single cloud.
Neither has my dad. But he still carries an *umbrella* everywhere.
Mom's been in the *hospital* since spring.
Every night, Dad tucks me in and says, Mom is going to be *fine*.
And every night, the sky stays *clear*.
But last night, I couldn't sleep.
I looked out the window, and Dad was standing in the backyard.
Holding that *umbrella*.
Above him was the biggest *storm* I'd ever seen.
He'd been going out there every night, so I would never see the rain.
Every, she's going to be fine, was a *lie*.
I ran outside and stood right next to him.
I took his hand and said, Dad, *we're* going to be fine.
And for the first time, a tiny cloud appeared over *my* head.
Dad smiled, and held the umbrella over *both* of us.
In this town, some lies are worth getting *wet* for.
